about: The same comparisons with a PIP as an operand: a GENERAL PIP whose pinned body is a list, an object, null, empty, a number, a boolean, or an error status, and a HEADER PIP whose header holds one or several comma-separated values. One probe per operator, side, PIP value shape and kind of the other operand that no golden reached, so that each tells whether the PIP acts as an attribute holding the same JSON would.
